method: Meta Ad Library API (ads_library_search), US, active ads, checked 2026-09-29. Longevity = days since ad_delivery_start_time. The API returns newest ads first, so older ads were surfaced with narrow keyword slices (kids, poop, bloating, GLP-1, multivitamin, greens powder); 'longest running' means longest seen, not guaranteed longest. Formats, body text, reach and spend are not returned by the API (unverified). 'formats' is left empty on purpose so the planner isn't skewed by guesses.
